settings.title: Settings
settings.theme_help: Choose the color theme for the interface. You can choose between System (follows your device settings), Light, or Dark.
settings.language_help: Choose the interface language. Auto detects from your browser settings.
settings.api_key_help: Set the API Key if you are using --api-key option for the server.
settings.system_message_help: The starting message that defines how model should behave.
settings.show_system_message_help: Display the system message at the top of each conversation.
settings.paste_long_text_to_file_len: Paste long text to file length
settings.paste_long_text_to_file_len_help: On pasting long text, it will be converted to a file. You can control the file length by setting the value of this parameter. Value 0 means disable.
settings.send_on_enter_help: Use Enter to send messages and Shift + Enter for new lines. When disabled, use Ctrl/Cmd + Enter.
settings.auto_mic_on_empty_help: Automatically show microphone button instead of send button when textarea is empty for models with audio modality support.
settings.enable_continue_generation_help: Enable "Continue" button for assistant messages, including reasoning models.
settings.enable_discover_models_help: Show the Discover Models sidebar action to browse and download HuggingFace GGUF models. Turns the Hugging Face Hub API on while it is enabled. Only available in router mode.
settings.use_hugging_face_hub: Use the Hugging Face Hub API
settings.use_hugging_face_hub_help: Fetch model display data (avatars, context length, chat template) and everything in the Discover Models view from the Hugging Face Hub API. Locked on while Discover Models is enabled; can be turned on alone for just the display data.
settings.conversation_title_help: Choose how conversation titles are generated. The first non-empty line uses a fast deterministic rule; the LLM option uses a model-generated title from the first message exchange.
settings.title_first_line: Use first non-empty line for the conversation title
settings.title_generation_prompt_help: Optional template for the title generation prompt. Use {{USER}} for the user message and {{ASSISTANT}} for the assistant message.
settings.copy_text_attachments_as_plain_text: Copy text attachments as plain text
settings.copy_text_attachments_as_plain_text_help: When copying a message with text attachments, combine them into a single plain text string instead of a special format that can be pasted back as attachments.
settings.pdf_as_image_help: Parse PDF as image instead of text. Automatically falls back to text processing for non-vision models.
settings.max_image_resolution_help: Images larger than this will be resized before sending to server. Set to 0 to disable.
settings.show_message_stats_help: Display generation statistics (tokens/second, token count, duration) below each assistant message.
settings.show_agentic_turn_stats: Show statistics for individual agentic turns
settings.show_agentic_turn_stats_help: Display per-turn statistics (tokens, duration) under each turn in agentic responses. Shown only when "Show message generation statistics" is enabled.
settings.show_thought_in_progress_help: Expand thought process by default when generating messages.
settings.show_tool_call_in_progress_help: Expand tool call details while the call is being generated and executed, and collapse them again once its result is in. Mirrors "Show thought in progress". Tool calls you expand or collapse by hand keep your choice.
settings.always_show_tool_call_content_help: Keep tool call details expanded after completion. Takes precedence over "Show tool call in progress", which only covers the in-flight phases.
settings.render_user_content_as_markdown_help: Render user messages using markdown formatting in the chat. Turn this off to keep a message exactly as typed; @-mention badges show either way.
settings.render_thinking_as_markdown_help: Render the reasoning/thinking block content as formatted Markdown instead of plain text.
settings.full_height_code_blocks_help: Always display code blocks at their full natural height, overriding any height limits.
settings.disable_auto_scroll_help: Disable automatic scrolling while messages stream so you can control the viewport position manually.
settings.always_show_sidebar_on_desktop_help: Always keep the sidebar visible on desktop instead of auto-hiding it.
settings.conversation_tabs_help: Show open chats as browser-style tabs above the conversation, one per open chat. When disabled, only one chat is shown at a time.
settings.show_raw_model_names_help: Display full raw model identifiers (e.g. "ggml-org/GLM-4.7-Flash-GGUF:Q8_0") instead of parsed names with badges.
settings.show_model_quantization_help: Display quantization badges (e.g. Q8_0, Q4_K_M) next to model names throughout the interface.
settings.show_model_tags_help: Display model tags (e.g. "vision", "reasoning") next to model names throughout the interface.
settings.show_model_capabilities_in_selector: Show model modalities & capabilities in models selector
settings.show_model_capabilities_in_selector_help: Show the modality and capability icons (vision, audio, reasoning, tools) on the models selector rows.
settings.show_model_org_name: Show organization name in model selector
settings.show_model_org_name_help: Display the organization name alongside model names in the model selector, in the trigger and in the model rows.
settings.show_build_version_help: Display the current build version in the bottom-right corner of the interface.
settings.show_full_path_in_mentions_help: Display the full file system path inside file and folder @-mention badges instead of just the file or folder name.
settings.group_models_by_family_help: Group models into families (e.g. "Qwen") in the model picker and the models manager. Turn it off to list every model on its own.
settings.mcp_servers_help: Configure MCP servers as a JSON list. Use the form in the MCP Client settings section to edit.
settings.agentic_max_turns_help: Maximum number of tool execution cycles before stopping (prevents infinite loops).
settings.mcp_request_timeout_help: Timeout for individual MCP tool calls.
settings.mention_search_depth_help: How many directory levels below the working directory the @-mention file search descends. Larger values surface deeply nested files but take longer on large trees.
settings.temperature_help: Controls the randomness of the generated text by affecting the probability distribution of the output tokens. Higher = more random, lower = more focused.
settings.dynatemp_range_help: Addon for the temperature sampler. The added value to the range of dynamic temperature, which adjusts probabilities by entropy of tokens.
settings.dynatemp_exponent_help: Addon for the temperature sampler. Smoothes out the probability redistribution based on the most probable token.
settings.top_p_help: Limits tokens to those that together have a cumulative probability of at least p
settings.min_p_help: Limits tokens based on the minimum probability for a token to be considered, relative to the probability of the most likely token.
settings.xtc_probability_help: XTC sampler cuts out top tokens; this parameter controls the chance of cutting tokens at all. 0 disables XTC.
settings.xtc_threshold_help: XTC sampler cuts out top tokens; this parameter controls the token probability that is required to cut that token.
settings.typ_p_help: Sorts and limits tokens based on the difference between log-probability and entropy.
settings.max_tokens_help: The maximum number of token per output. Use -1 for infinite (no limit).
settings.samplers_help: The order at which samplers are applied, in simplified way. Default is "top_k;typ_p;top_p;min_p;temperature": top_k->typ_p->top_p->min_p->temperature
settings.backend_sampling_help: Enable backend-based samplers. When enabled, supported samplers run on the accelerator backend for faster sampling.
settings.repeat_last_n_help: Last n tokens to consider for penalizing repetition
settings.repeat_penalty_help: Controls the repetition of token sequences in the generated text
settings.presence_penalty_help: Limits tokens based on whether they appear in the output or not.
settings.frequency_penalty_help: Limits tokens based on how often they appear in the output.
settings.dry_multiplier_help: DRY sampling reduces repetition in generated text even across long contexts. This parameter sets the DRY sampling multiplier.
settings.dry_base_help: DRY sampling reduces repetition in generated text even across long contexts. This parameter sets the DRY sampling base value.
settings.dry_allowed_length_help: DRY sampling reduces repetition in generated text even across long contexts. This parameter sets the allowed length for DRY sampling.
settings.dry_penalty_last_n_help: DRY sampling reduces repetition in generated text even across long contexts. This parameter sets DRY penalty for the last n tokens.
settings.pre_encode_conversation_help: After each response, re-submit the conversation to pre-fill the server KV cache. Makes the next turn faster since the prompt is already encoded while you read the response.
settings.disable_reasoning_parsing_help: Send reasoning_format=none so the server returns thinking tokens inline instead of extracting them into a separate field.
settings.exclude_reasoning_from_context_help: Strip thinking from previous messages before sending. When off, thinking is sent back via the reasoning_content field so the model sees its own chain-of-thought across turns.
settings.show_raw_output_switch_help: Show toggle button to display messages as plain text instead of Markdown-formatted content
settings.js_sandbox_enabled_help: Expose a run_javascript tool to the model. Code runs in a Web Worker inside a sandboxed iframe with an opaque origin, isolated from the WebUI and its API, with a hard timeout.
settings.symbolic_math_enabled_help: Pre-load nerdamer in the sandbox for symbolic computation: simplify, diff, integrate, solve, and more. Requires "JavaScript sandbox tool" to be enabled.
settings.custom_json_help: Custom JSON parameters to send to the API. Must be valid JSON format.
settings.custom_css_help: CSS injected into the page at runtime. Set it here, or ship it server side via the --ui-config customCss field.
settings.saved_in_localstorage: Settings are saved in browser's localStorage
settings.export_conversations_description: Download your conversations as a ZIP of JSONL files. This includes all messages, attachments, and conversation history.
settings.import_conversations_description: Import one or more conversations from a previously exported ZIP or JSONL file. This will merge with your existing conversations.
settings.delete_all_conversations_description: Permanently delete all conversations and their messages. This action cannot be undone. Consider exporting your conversations first if you want to keep a backup.
settings.export_settings_description: Export your chat settings and preferences as a JSON file.
settings.import_settings_description: Import chat settings from a previously exported JSON file. This will merge with your existing settings.
settings.delete_all_conversations_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete all conversations? This action cannot be undone and will permanently remove all your conversations and messages.

chat.delete_single_description: Are you sure you want to delete this message? This action cannot be undone.
chat.fork_description: Create a new conversation branching from this message.

chat.file_search_disabled: File search is disabled - type a full path and press Enter, or enable "Search files" in Settings > Tools

navigation.delete_conversation_confirm: Delete "{name}"? This action cannot be undone.

dialogs.model_not_available_description: The requested model could not be found. Select an available model to continue.
